newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.303pts to 101.888.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.303pts to 101.888.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.303 points in Thursday's trading to 101.888, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.483 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.578 points to 98.443 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.355 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 14.494 points to 1,102.768.
